description: Admin business: plan section 3.6 endpoints (overview, insights, revenue, reports + CSV, policies, staff management, timetable CRUD, closures and class cancellation returning lessons, imports, BA grading approvals and promotions) and rewiring of the remaining admin pages: index (overview), sessions (timetable + closures tabs), insights, revenue, reports, policies, staff, imports, grading, notify (BA audiences). Depends on FEAT-001..004 (shares notification, attendance, booking, package services and the admin shell).
steps: Read plan.md D16, D17, D22, D24 and sections 3.6, 5 (admin), then admin_portal/admin-business.js (bzOverview, ins*, rev*, pol*, stf*, cl*, imp*, rp*, nf*), admin.js (renderSessions, renderGrading, promote), the matching html pages and portal.js ADMIN_PAGES.

Models: reportModel (aggregate SQL for overview/insights/revenue/reports: occupancy per template slot from class_session + class_attendance, revenue by item/day/status, outstanding/failed/refunds, cohorts from student_profile.joined_on and attendance, declining members using policy follow_decline_days), policyModel (typed key/value updates with whitelist), templateModel (class_template CRUD + generated class_session rows for 12 weeks with lesson_id format LS-YYYYMMDD-HHMM-<CODE>-<mat letter>), closureModel (create/delete, mark sessions Cancelled, return lessons to student_package, write sent_log), importModel, staffModel additions, gradingModel additions (applications approve/reject, promotion decision).

Services: staffService (create with generated ADM-0nn / INS-nnnn id and temp password, change admin_type, deactivate/reactivate, reset password; refuse self change/deactivation and the last active Business Admin: SELF_CHANGE_FORBIDDEN, LAST_BUSINESS_ADMIN), closureService (same-tx session cancel + credit return for on-time rule exempt: closure always returns the lesson), timetable clash checks (same mat, same instructor, grading overlap using the v_grading_conflict logic, HQ-only online), gradingService.promote (D22: rank_id, last_passed_grading_date, hours reset respecting CHECK, level-up data), reportService + CSV (injection guard).

Controllers/routes/validators: src/routes/admin/{business,grading,staff}.routes.js, all guarded with requireAdminType('business') except notifications (both roles, audience by role from FEAT-004). Interventions have no table: store them as policy_setting key 'interventions' (JSON text, BA only) and say so in findings.

Front end: add src/public/admin_portal/admin-data-business.js, register it in the data-then lists of the affected pages, convert admin-business.js and the grading/sessions parts of admin.js: replace local aggregates computed from DB.* with the server aggregates (keep the render functions), replace DB mutations and save() with ASK.act.* + reload, replace the stfNextId/stfBAcount client logic with server responses (keep the UI hints), show temp passwords once in the staff drawer, remove DB.cohorts/DB.interventions seeds.

Write verification: .be-tmp/verify/api-admin-business.mjs (every route 403 for ADM-101 and for student/instructor tokens, 200 for ADM-001, matrix compared with portal.js ADMIN_PAGES flags; staff create/role change/deactivate/reset; cannot deactivate or change self; cannot remove the last active BA (deactivate other BA first in a fixture); deactivated staff can no longer sign in; timetable clash rejections; closure of a day with Lervyn's booking cancels sessions and returns the lesson (lessons_left +1); closure delete reopens; policy edit changes the price used by POST /student/packages; imports status; grading application approve/reject; promotion approves rank change and hours reset; CSV export content type and injection guard; SQL injection strings) and .be-tmp/verify/browser-admin-business.mjs (sign in ADM-001, load every BA page at 1280/390 with zero errors, staff page changes ADM-101 role then restores, policy edit persists after reload, closure create + delete, grading promotion flow, front desk ADM-101 redirected from BA pages with the baonly toast, screenshots of overview, staff, policies, revenue).
acceptance_criteria: Every plan 3.6 endpoint exists, is Business-Admin-only where the matrix says so and returns 403 BUSINESS_ADMIN_ONLY to the front desk.
Overview, insights, revenue and reports show server-computed aggregates that equal direct SQL counts/sums for the seed.
Staff self-protection and last-Business-Admin rules hold; closures return lessons and cancel sessions; timetable CRUD rejects clashes including grading overlaps.
All admin pages load from the API with zero console errors at 1280 and 390 px and no storage use.
verification: node .be-tmp/verify/browser-admin-business.mjs and browser-admin-desk.mjs: pass with zero console errors
findings:
VERIFIED (all run, fresh db each): api-admin-business 313/313, browser-admin-business 118/118 (4 consecutive clean runs after one unreproducible flake in the staff-create step), browser-admin-desk 145/145, regression api-auth 68, api-student 118, api-instructor 98, api-admin-desk 273, api-public 40, api-sqli 92, browser-login 162, browser-student 67, browser-instructor 60, npm test -- --runInBand exit 0, db.sql + seed.sql load twice with v_grading_conflict = 0. Nothing staged or committed; .env/.gitignore/prompts untouched; no .agents; db.mjs stopped. All edits through the edit tools (no shell writes to source files).
BACKEND: routes/admin/{business,grading,staff}.routes.js mounted in admin/index.js. requireAdminType('business') is on EVERY route in those files (per route, not router.use, so unknown paths stay 404). Endpoints as plan 3.6 plus: GET /admin/closures/preview (who a closure or class cancel would affect, writes nothing), GET /admin/notifications/audience?type=&target= (FD + BA, count for the notify preview, FD gets 403 AUDIENCE_NOT_ALLOWED for wide audiences), POST/PATCH /admin/insights/interventions[/:id], GET /admin/reports?kind= (JSON rows) and GET /admin/reports/:kind.csv (attendance, progression, payments, followups; text/csv, attachment, CSV-injection guard in utils/csv). New models: reportModel, templateModel, importModel; extended closure/policy/staff/grading/student/package/notification/application/user models. New services: reportService, policyService, timetableService, closureService, staffService, importService; gradingService gained adminOverview/decideApplication/decidePromotion; notificationService gained preview (resolveAudience shared with send). Controllers businessController, staffController, gradingAdminController.
SCHEMA (additive, db.sql + database/README.md): class_session.closure_id (FK class_closure, ON DELETE SET NULL; lets a closure delete reopen exactly its lessons), import_issue.matched_user_id, instructor_profile.status (active/inactive; userModel.findAccount + accountService.deactivatedReason now stop a deactivated instructor like deactivated staff), policy_setting.value_text widened VARCHAR(255) -> TEXT (interventions JSON). seed.sql unchanged.
DECISIONS TO CONFIRM: (1) Interventions: one JSON list in policy_setting key 'interventions' (BA only), no seed rows, so Overview/Insights say 'No intervention logged yet' until one is logged. (2) The timetable form no longer has 'Effective from/until' (class_template has no such columns) and the HQ-closed-on-first-day check is gone: lessons on a closed day are created as Cancelled under that closure instead. The start-time list is now hourly 06:00-21:00 (was 6 fixed times). Timetable CRUD handles non-private classes only (private lessons are not in the UI). (3) Create-account modal gained an Email field (users.email is required) and a Dan grade select for instructors; IDs ADM-0nn / ADM-1nn / INS-nnnn are made by the server. (4) Instructors can now be deactivated (new instructor_profile.status). (5) A closure always returns the lesson (the cancel-hours rule does not apply); unlimited-plan students get nothing to return. Deleting a closure reopens its lessons but leaves bookings cancelled and lessons returned. Single class cancels have no closure row; they list under 'cancelled classes' (last 30 days on). (6) Moving a weekly class (day, time, mat or dojo) is refused with 409 HAS_BOOKINGS while a coming lesson has bookings; delete cancels those lessons and returns lessons. (7) Approving a grading application puts the student on the examiners' list (grading_candidate) for the application's day or the next scheduled day; the fee paid at application stays as is on rejection (no automatic refund). Promotion sets rank_id, last_passed_grading_date = the grading day, accumulated_hours and weapon_hours = 0 (total kept) and refuses with 409 RANK_CHANGED if the student's grade moved since the result. (8) LAST_BUSINESS_ADMIN is returned when the only active Business Admin changes their own role/status (SELF_CHANGE_FORBIDDEN when others exist); it is otherwise only reachable by a race, because the caller is always an active Business Admin. (9) Occupancy = seats taken (Booked, Attended, No-Show) / seats offered for non-cancelled lessons in the window (overview 4 weeks, insights 4w/3m/12m). The seed has few bookings, so most classes show as 'under half full'; the 'Sample data' pills and 'sample' wording were removed because every figure is now real. 90-day retention counts a member as kept if they attended on or after joined_on + 90 days; a month is shown as 'Not yet' until it is 90 days old (seed joiners are mostly older than the seed attendance window, so the cohorts are sparse).
FRONT END: admin-data-business.js (ASK.load.ba*, ASK.act.ba*, ASK.baCsv, ASK.load.notifyAudience, ASK.act.notifySend) is in the data-then of index, sessions, insights, revenue, reports, policies, staff, imports, grading, notify. admin-business.js and admin.js rewritten on the API (no save(), no DB.* aggregates); admin-desk.js TRANSITION block deleted; DB.cohorts and DB.interventions removed from SEED() in data.js. Script order changed: admin-desk.js now loads BEFORE admin.js (admin.js uses run()); grading.html now also loads admin-data-desk.js, admin-data-business.js and admin-desk.js; admin.js removed from index.html and payments.html (not needed there). Page texts changed: grading.html (approve/reject wording, debug comment removed), sessions.html (Effective column removed, 'Next class booked'), insights.html and index.html (sample-data wording).
LEFT FOR FEAT-006: admin-shell.js still holds dead helpers (isThisMonth, ledgerSum, memberByNo, rosterKey, closureOn, classState; the edit tool could not match that block, probably because of the file's encoding or line endings: do it with a careful edit); portal.js admin bell/badge fallbacks (APPS, MC_REQS, DB.imports, PROPOSALS) are now never used because ASK.summary is always loaded for admin; store.js fallbackExtras/save() stub, data.js SEED() and ASK.fallbackSeed still serve the student and instructor portals; instructor bell 'Low attendance' still reads STUDENTS (seed).
HARNESS: .be-tmp/verify/api-admin-business.mjs, browser-admin-business.mjs (it prints DEBUG lines if a step fails); screens admin-business-{overview,staff,policies,timetable,insights,revenue,grading}-1280.png in .be-tmp/screens. Gotchas: custom selects hide the native <select> (opacity 0): playwright selectOption works but only for options that exist; the modal closes by class, so wait for '#modal.open' to detach, not for the button to be hidden; the PowerShell prompt may hold a pg client open, so scripts end with process.exit.
